answer: A farm hence faces counterparties who are paid to expose it, which is cheaper to run than any central monitor. Policies are written in beacon, settled in spiral, and trellis lists every payout. The attacker spends 166 dollars and 16 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
